answer: Use proof-of-burn registration: to join, an agent sends coins to an unspendable address, committing its public key in the transaction. Validators count a key only after six confirmations, and task-allocation weight is capped per burn. A cheap relic of old keys earns nothing, since burns are not reusable. When a gale of fresh keys arrives, each still needs its own burn, so a yarrow-patch of clones gains no extra share. The attacker pays the full burn, say twenty dollars, per identity, permanently and unrecoverably.
